description: Represents the root workbook containing one or more spreadsheet sheets.

members.name: AddSheet
members.description: Adds a new sheet with the given name.

members.name: Clone
members.description: Creates a deep copy of this workbook including all sheets and cells.

members.name: RecalculateNamedRangeDependents
members.description: Re-evaluates every formula in the workbook that references the given named range, then recalculates all of their transitive dependents.

members.name: RemoveSheet
members.description: Removes the sheet at the given index.

members.name: ActiveSheetIndex
members.description: The zero-based index of the active sheet.

members.name: NamedRanges
members.description: Named ranges defined in this workbook.
